training_identity.interpretation: checkpoint selection and current adapter bytes can be verified against raw training_result/trainer_state; historical base weight/tokenizer commit and exact loaded runtime snapshot lack a contemporaneous receipt; current cache/artifact presence cannot fill that gap

findings.claim: Raw bootstrap trajectories contain 60 unique identities per arm, 10 per family; all 60 pairs match task id, split, family, nominal seed, schedule index, reset-order position, horizon, initial observation hash, and reset hash; raw success is 3/60 vs 48/60, with 45 wins, 0 losses, 15 ties.
findings.scope: episode records and matching fields, not hidden launch/runtime state

findings.claim: The final base-arm CellPhone episode has one row but termination_reason=selection_failure, only one recorded step, truncated=true, and no terminal won value. It is a recorded failed/invalid episode, not a missing identity; it is not evidence of an unrecorded retry.

Valid-unseen raw 60 episode rows join one-to-one to all 60 frozen schedule identities; 49 terminal wins, 10 per family, no overlap with the SFT train-development identities or the 1200 accepted dataset tasks.
findings.scope: valid_unseen frozen schedule and completed raw rows

findings.claim: The balanced dataset contains 1200 unique tasks/20967 rows; its source train traj_data.json and game.tw-pddl hashes match the raw data files for all 1273 accepted-candidate task IDs across initial and pick-two extension files.
findings.scope: source file identity/hash only; planner authorship is supported by contemporaneous report labeling, not independently reconstructible from missing rejected-run logs

findings.claim: Contemporaneous SFT base-model/tokenizer revision and full loaded runtime identity receipt are unavailable; adapter_config.revision is null.
findings.scope: cannot prove historical base/tokenizer bytes from current cache

findings.claim: A bootstrap online-evaluation launch/run manifest and per-candidate raw records for the 596 rejected trajectories were not located in the enumerated artifact tree.
findings.scope: report-level aggregate cannot establish hidden attempts or candidate-by-candidate disposition

findings.claim: The versioned sft_training_protocol.json declares split manifest e6695359... and exclusion manifest 8e0d04d3..., while the corresponding currently preserved sft_task_splits.json and sft_task_exclusions.json byte hashes are 53471633... and fdbe3b1c... respectively; the files do not satisfy those declared hashes.
findings.scope: byte-level current-source binding mismatch; does not by itself establish what files were actually loaded during historical training, and earlier manifest versions were not found

provenance_gaps: No full model-load/runtime receipt or preserved base/tokenizer revision found among the specified raw SFT artifacts; adapter_config.revision is null.

No per-run launch/supervisor receipt found beside bootstrap online trajectories in the enumerated artifact tree; single observed record per schedule identity does not prove there were no discarded/retried attempts.
Raw valid_unseen trajectories and exact 60-row schedule are present; no same-schedule base arm exists, so 49/60 is a one-arm descriptive result, not a causal SFT gain.

Expert task-level outcomes include only accepted dataset rows; 596 rejected-candidate outcomes are summarized by count/reason but underlying per-candidate raw evidence was not found in listed artifacts.

self_improvement_interpretation.source: hand-coded successful expert trajectories, not actor-generated self-sampling
self_improvement_interpretation.strongest_supported_claim: SFT-P0 expert-policy imitation is associated with a large matched improvement on the same 60 consumed train-development episodes, conditional on historical model identity claims; source audit confirms expert labels, not self-generated experience.
